meal.name: Moroccan-Spiced Beef Meatballs in Tomato Sauce with White Beans & Roasted Bell Peppers
day_of_steps: 1. Combine 200 g (Diego) / 140 g (Diego) — wait: 200 g (Diego) / 140 g (Diana) lean beef mince with 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, ½ tsp coriander powder, ½ tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp dried oregano, salt, pepper; shape into 4–5 meatballs per portion.
2. Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a wide pan over medium-high; sear meatballs 3–4 min turning until browned all over.
3. Add 300 g canned chopped tomatoes, 100 ml water, pinch chilli flakes; simmer with meatballs 12–15 min.
4. Drain and rinse 240 g (combined) canned white beans; add 120 g (Diego) / 80 g (Diana) white beans to sauce in last 5 min to warm through.
5. Warm 80 g (Diego) / 60 g (Diana) roasted bell peppers (roasted fresh today: toss 200g sliced peppers with 1 tsp olive oil, roast 200°C 20 min) alongside.
6. Ladle meatballs, beans and sauce into bowls; arrange peppers on the side. Serve 60 g cherry tomatoes each on the side. Drink 500 ml water.

kefir & blueberry smoothie + fried eggs.name: Kefir & Blueberry Smoothie + Fried Eggs on Sourdough with Gruyère & Cherry Tomatoes

meal.name: Kefir & Blueberry Smoothie + Fried Eggs on Sourdough with Gruyère & Cherry Tomatoes
day_of_steps: 1. Blend 250 ml kefir with 100 g (Diego) / 80 g (Diana) blueberries; pour into glasses.
2. Toast 40 g (Diego) / 30 g (Diana) sourdough.
3. Fry 2 eggs (Diego) / 1 egg (Diana) in ½ tsp olive oil; season with salt and pepper.
4. Sprinkle 25 g (Diego) / 20 g (Diana) grated Gruyère on toast; let melt. Top with fried eggs and 60 g halved cherry tomatoes each.
5. Serve immediately with smoothie. Drink 500 ml water.

algerian-style beef kefta with chickpeas.name: Algerian-Style Beef Kefta with Chickpeas, Roasted Bell Peppers & Wholewheat Couscous

meal.name: Algerian-Style Beef Kefta with Chickpeas, Roasted Bell Peppers & Wholewheat Couscous
day_of_steps: 1. Mix 200 g (Diego) / 140 g (Diana) lean beef mince with 1 minced garlic clove, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, ½ tsp dried oregano, ½ tsp coriander powder, salt, pepper; shape into small flat patties.
2. Slice 1 red + 1 yellow bell pepper; toss with 1 tsp olive oil, salt, smoked paprika; roast at 200°C for 20 min.
3. Pan-fry kefta patties in 1 tsp olive oil over medium-high heat, 3–4 min per side.
4. Boil water; pour over 60 g (Diego) / 45 g (Diana) dry wholewheat couscous; cover 5 min; fluff.
5. Drain and rinse 120 g (Diego) / 80 g (Diana) canned chickpeas; warm in the pan with 1 tsp olive oil and a pinch cumin for 3 min.
6. Plate couscous, arrange kefta and chickpeas alongside roasted peppers. Serve 1 orange each. Drink 500 ml water.

meal.name: Creamy Tomato Tilapia with White Beans, Spinach & Mushrooms on Sweet Potato Mash
day_of_steps: 1. Peel and cube 200 g (Diego) / 150 g (Diana) sweet potato; boil in salted water 12–15 min until tender; drain; mash with 1 tsp olive oil, salt and pepper per portion.
2. In a wide pan, heat 1 tsp olive oil over medium; sauté 80 g sliced cremini mushrooms per person 4 min.
3. Add 150 g passata + 50 ml water + 1 tsp dried basil + ½ tsp garlic powder + pinch chilli flakes; simmer 5 min.
4. Add 80 g (Diego) / 60 g (Diana) drained canned white beans; stir in 60 g spinach per person until wilted.
5. Season 200 g (Diego) / 140 g (Diana) tilapia fillets with salt, pepper, ½ tsp smoked paprika; add to sauce; cover and cook 8–10 min until opaque.
6. Serve tilapia and sauce over sweet potato mash. Drink 500 ml water.

kefir & strawberry smoothie + fried eggs.name: Kefir & Strawberry Smoothie + Fried Eggs on Sourdough with Feta, Rocket & Sliced Mushrooms

meal.name: Kefir & Strawberry Smoothie + Fried Eggs on Sourdough with Feta, Rocket & Sliced Mushrooms
day_of_steps: 1. Blend 250 ml kefir with 100 g (Diego) / 80 g (Diana) strawberries; pour into glasses.
2. Toast 40 g (Diego) / 30 g (Diana) sourdough.
3. In a small pan, sauté 40 g sliced cremini mushrooms per person in ¼ tsp olive oil for 3 min; season with black pepper.
4. Fry 2 eggs (Diego) / 1 egg (Diana) in ¼ tsp olive oil.
5. Arrange mushrooms on toast; top with fried eggs and 20 g (Diego) / 15 g (Diana) crumbled feta. Add 20 g rocket each.
6. Serve with smoothie. Drink 500 ml water.

asian soy-ginger tilapia bowl with stir-.name: Asian Soy-Ginger Tilapia Bowl with Stir-Fried Broccoli, Carrots & Mushrooms on Brown Rice

meal.name: Asian Soy-Ginger Tilapia Bowl with Stir-Fried Broccoli, Carrots & Mushrooms on Brown Rice
day_of_steps: 1. Cook 80 g (Diego) / 60 g (Diana) dry brown rice per package instructions.
2. Mix: 2 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil, ½ tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp coriander powder, pinch chilli flakes. Coat 200 g (Diego) / 140 g (Diana) tilapia; bake at 200°C for 12–14 min.
3. Stir-fry 100 g broccoli + 60 g sliced carrots + 70 g sliced cremini mushrooms per person in 1 tsp olive oil over high heat for 5–6 min; season with black pepper and soy sauce splash.
4. Build bowl: rice base, tilapia on top, stir-fried veg alongside. Drizzle ½ tsp sesame oil per person.
5. Serve ½ banana each. Drink 500 ml water.

smoky beef & lentil stuffed bell peppers.name: Smoky Beef & Lentil Stuffed Bell Peppers with Tomato Sauce

meal.name: Smoky Beef & Lentil Stuffed Bell Peppers with Tomato Sauce
day_of_steps: 1. Preheat oven to 190°C. Halve 4 bell peppers (2 red, 2 yellow) lengthwise; scoop out seeds; brush with ½ tsp olive oil; arrange in a baking dish.
2. Brown 200 g (Diego) / 140 g (Diana) lean beef mince in a pan with 1 tsp olive oil over medium-high heat; add 1 minced garlic clove, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cumin, ½ tsp dried oregano.
3. Add 100 g (Diego) / 70 g (Diana) rinsed canned lentils (or cooked from batch) + 100 g canned chopped tomatoes; simmer 5 min; season with salt and pepper.
4. Fill each pepper half generously with beef-lentil mixture. Pour 150 ml passata into base of dish around peppers.
5. Bake covered with foil 20–22 min; uncover last 5 min.
6. Sprinkle 25 g (Diego) / 20 g (Diana) crumbled feta on top. Serve with 60 g rocket (dressed with 1 tsp olive oil + balsamic vinegar) and 60 g cherry tomatoes each. Drink 500 ml water.
